patch.value: GH-1532: preserve every tracker cache exclusion when nested init shares a repository

https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1532 reproduces nested pm init replacing the one managed runtime-cache fence, leaving enclosing tracker caches unignored. Live SDK reproduction confirms outer cache becomes unignored while nested cache is ignored. Preserve existing tracker rules and unrelated user content, support either init order, and keep every tracker eval-queries.json version controllable. Merge-attribute preservation was not broken in the independent issue reproduction and must remain covered.
